exit_criteria: Approved rows recorded for context reset semantics, protocol-safe auto-pickup, agency levels, roadmap-level autonomy, minimal reset packets, regression guards, and graph-owned doc-code links.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from CodeWiki source refs; the agent may refresh context when useful.

requirements.text: CodeWiki context reset is a first-class semantic boundary rebuilt from CodeWiki source truth instead of old chat history.
Context reset flows must be protocol-safe and never auto-continue from an assistant-leaf message.
Automatic context refresh must be gated by safe lifecycle checks, visible status, and fallback behavior.
Reset packets stay minimal and source-backed; durable rules live in KB/skills and are read on demand.
Regression tests must prove invalid assistant-leaf continuation cannot recur.
After safe reset, CodeWiki auto-picks up through a protocol-safe source-backed kickoff when agency policy allows continuation.
Agency level is configurable as task, sprint, or roadmap and controls approval cadence while hard gates remain mandatory.
Routine knowledge frontmatter code_paths are deprecated; graph derives doc-code links from source-backed inputs, with code_paths only as optional explicit overrides.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Context reset source of truth and protocol safety documented
evidence_mapping.evidence: Updated agency, adapters, API, compilers, product automation, lexicon, and diagrams to define source-backed reset, protocol-safe custom kickoff, and no assistant-leaf auto-continue.
Updated agency, roadmap, API, compilers, product automation, lexicon, and diagrams to describe agency level/approval cadence and roadmap-level continuation under hard gates.
Updated knowledge and graph specs and data-model diagram to deprecate routine frontmatter code_paths and route machine doc-code mapping to graph-derived inputs.

accepted_decisions.summary: CodeWiki owns context reset from source truth and should auto-pick up within configured agency level.
Agency level is task/sprint/roadmap and controls approval cadence, not hard gates.
Routine knowledge frontmatter code_paths are deprecated; graph owns generated doc-code links.

product_impact: Users can choose agency level task/sprint/roadmap.

Automation remains visibly gated by hard stop conditions.

Graph/lint/audit must stop treating routine knowledge-frontmatter code_paths as required doc-code mapping truth.
